packages.notes: Experimental AISteering + never-throwing delivery receipts and idempotent IDs; generateText/streamText, agent and Swift-native options forward steering. Steering append/prepareStep replacement, current/initial/response request state, per-step delivery metadata, final-answer selection, structured streaming boundaries, no continuation after interruption/error or unresolved tool results. Typed onStepError callback with real step number, previous steps, request/model identity and error; once-only stream failure closure and telemetry stepError. Agent onError before rethrowing original ordinary error, onAbort only on streaming cancellation/timeouts; native cause traversal up to four links. Telemetry aiVersion on copied events plus both model/tool execution contexts. fixJson does not retain incomplete minus as the first array element. AIModelFeatureSupport, AIModelCapabilities, AIModelEntry<RequestConfiguration>, AIProviderOptionDefinitions and AIModelProviderOptions native equivalents; no conflict with existing ModelCapability operation enum. Codable capability/support/section/option types preserve omitted vs false vs unknown vs conditional, optional configuration and realtime transport/connection names. Port shared async credential resolution and reasoning mapping: optional/default/override handling, closest supported effort, none-budget warning and percentage defaults.
